    • checkFcnRec

      public static List<IResponse> checkFcnRec(SymbolTable symTable, boolean global, IExpr.ISymbol id, List<IExpr.IDeclaration> params, ISort result, IExpr expr)
      Type-checks a define-fun-rec command: verifies the symbol is new, validates sorts, pre-adds the function to the symbol table so the body may call it recursively, then checks the body expression. On success the entry's definition is set. Delegates to checkFcnsRec as the N=1 case (a singleton declaration group).

    • checkFcnsRec

      public static List<IResponse> checkFcnsRec(SymbolTable symTable, boolean global, List<IExpr.IFunctionDeclaration> decls, List<IExpr> bodies)
      Type-checks a define-funs-rec command: for each declaration verifies the symbol is new and sorts are valid, pre-adds all functions to the symbol table for mutual recursion, then checks each body expression. On success all entries' definitions are set.

      public static void clearSorts(IExpr expr) throws IVisitor.VisitorException

    • validate

      public static List<IResponse> validate(SMT.Configuration smtConfig, ICommand cmd)
      Validates non-syntactic well-formedness of a command (user IDs, duplicate names, list sizes). Returns a list of errors; an empty list means the command is well-formed.

    • validateDatatypeNames

      public static List<IResponse> validateDatatypeNames(SymbolTable symTable, SMT.Configuration smtConfig, List<IExpr.ISortDeclaration> sortDecls, List<ISort.IDatatype> datatypes)
      Checks that constructor and selector names introduced by a datatype group are not already defined (neither in the symbol table nor duplicated within the group). Returns any errors found; empty list means all names are fresh.
